summary: Reviewed Plesk service, resource and workflow map loaded from git by default. Live API observation enriches instance data but never grants a new executable route.

environment.isolation: One baseline serves many panels; credentials and observations are scoped by instance_id.

services.summary: Subscription, domain, mailbox and DNS operations available to the bound Plesk account.
Administrator REST surface under /api/v2; authority is not interchangeable with XML subscription ownership.
Installed extension inventory joined only with reviewed operation profiles.
Subscription-scoped file transport used after docroot observation and dry-run.
Alternative public DNS management plane selected only when the environment binding says Namecheap.

publish-site.outcome: Content is published only after live subscription and docroot observation.

publish-site-with-tls.outcome: Content and TLS are ready on the bound Plesk panel.

publish-site-with-managed-dns.outcome: Content, selected DNS management plane and TLS are reconciled by an ordered multi-connector plan.

create-mailbox.outcome: Mailbox exists on a subscription observed before mutation.

observe-topology.outcome: Current subscription and site topology are represented as twin facts.

plesk-admin-api-key.note: REST v2 is restricted to /api/v2/. Never used for subscription file writes.

plesk-xml-subscription-owner.authority: customer account that owns the subscription
plesk-xml-subscription-owner.note: The panel admin login and mailbox users are rejected by the XML API with 1001/1006. Using the admin credential here is the most common cause of a false 'panel unreachable' report.

plesk-sftp-subscription-user.note: Never equivalent to server administrator access; scoped to one subscription docroot.

plesk-root-ssh.note: Not implemented by the subscription transport. Declared so that a plan needing it fails with a named gap instead of silently attempting SFTP.

namecheap-dns-api.authority: DNS records for one Namecheap-managed zone
namecheap-dns-api.note: A vault handle representing the API user, key, username and allowlisted client IP; values never enter the twin map.

capabilities.summary: Subscription list and domain capacity, used for planning before any domain is created
Live docroot / www_root decision fact for one domain
Which plane actually answers for the hostname
Authoritative installed-extension state; the enrichment source for this map

preconditions: docroot fact documented in the plan

capabilities.summary: Write site content into the resolved docroot. Requires the docroot fact first so publishing cannot target a guessed path.
Create a mailbox on a subscription domain
Issue or renew a certificate through SSL It!. Depends on DNS authority because a certificate cannot be validated for a hostname this panel does not answer for.
Read the current DNS zone through the management plane selected by the environment binding.

preconditions: authority twin confirms Plesk management plane
explicit apply confirmation and authority remain external to the twin

capabilities.summary: Reconcile DNS through Plesk or Namecheap without changing the workflow; provider choice follows observed environment binding and route availability.
Server-level CLI utilities with no remote API equivalent. Declared but intentionally uncredentialed in the standard binding.
